endpoints.description: Summary of every FEMA disaster declaration (state, incident type, dates, program).
National Flood Insurance Program redacted claims data.
Catalog of every OpenFEMA dataset and its current version (use to discover entity names/versions).

limits.notes: No API key. $top caps at 10000 records per request; default page size is 1000. Paginate with $skip. No published hard quota.

llmDocs.summary: FEMA disaster declarations, National Flood Insurance Program claims, and individual/public assistance, queryable by state, incident type, and date.
llmDocs.queryGuide: Each dataset is a versioned path, e.g. /v2/DisasterDeclarationsSummaries. Filter with OData params: $filter (e.g. state eq 'TX'), $top (max 10000), $skip, $orderby, $select. Append $inlinecount=allpages&$metadata=off to control the metadata envelope. Call /v1/DataSets to discover entity names and their latest version.

exampleQueries.intent: Most recent 5 disaster declarations in Texas
Count of all NFIP flood claims for a county FIPS

gotchas: Filter/order params use the OData $ prefix: $filter, $top, $skip, $orderby, $select.
$filter string values use single quotes: state eq 'TX'.
Default page size is 1000 and $top maxes at 10000 — paginate large pulls with $skip.
Datasets are versioned (v1/v2/...); a renamed/retired version 404s. Check /v1/DataSets for the current version path.

compliance.redistributionNotes: US federal data, public domain. OpenFEMA terms require attribution and prohibit implying FEMA endorsement.
